finding.attribution: amount protection implicated for this source; no observed Charitree main effect or additional interaction
finding.recommendation: Do not accept opaque amount protection as semantically safe for this source. Keep rules unchanged pending human review; do not infer a global amount-rule removal or Charitree change.
limits: One fixed synthetic source, two reversed-order trials; identical output is not independent sampling or a population error rate.
Single-agent semantic review, not independent bilingual review.

No-rules arm uses production-style plain mode; selected-marker arms use HTML. Charitree-only provides an HTML control with visible amount, but an amount-only HTML/no-marker counterfactual was not requested or run.
No statement about other amounts, units, sources, deployed behavior or players.
